summary.name: LinkedIn Company Employees API
summary.one_liner: A hosted Apify actor that lists people who work at a given company on LinkedIn, with names, titles, locations and public profile URLs, optionally checking each profile for a current role.
keywords: employee list by title and city
use_cases: Talent mapping a competitor's team by title and city
Confirming which CRM contacts still work at an account
Checking founders and senior hires before an investor call
Feeding structured people data to an AI agent over MCP
summary.what_it_does: Takes a list of company LinkedIn URLs or company names and returns one row per person found in public search results. By default it opens each public profile and keeps only people whose profile shows a current role at the company, dropping those who have moved on. Optional filters narrow results by job title keywords and locations, and a cap sets the maximum number of people per company. Turning profile verification off gives a faster list built from search results alone, which may include people who have left. Each row includes name, title, location, profile URL, and a match reason and search query for auditing.
notable: Checks each public profile for a current role at the company by default, so former employees are dropped
Needs no LinkedIn login or cookie; uses public profiles and search results
Titles and locations can be used as filters, with each title keyword run as its own search
Structured output with verification flag, match reason, and fetch timestamp for deduplication across runs
caveats: Lists are partial: in testing roughly 10 to 45% of a small company, 7 to 19% of a mid-size one, and under 1% of a very large one
Billing is per person returned; company input count and max results per company drive cost
A fresh run with profile checks takes about 3 to 10 minutes per company
